name: pdf-md
description: Conversor PDF a Markdown de alta precisión, 100% local en el navegador.

scripts.selftest: vite build --config vite.selftest.config.ts --logLevel error && node node_modules/.selftest/selftest.js
scripts.debug:layout: ENTRY=scripts/debug-layout.ts vite build --config vite.selftest.config.ts --logLevel error && node node_modules/.selftest/debug-layout.js
scripts.check:markdown: ENTRY=scripts/check-markdown.ts vite build --config vite.selftest.config.ts --logLevel error && node node_modules/.selftest/check-markdown.js
scripts.check:queue: ENTRY=scripts/check-queue.ts vite build --config vite.selftest.config.ts --logLevel error && node node_modules/.selftest/check-queue.js
